title: Christmas Worksheets | Kindergarten Holiday Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.CC.B.5, K.MD.B.3, K.OA.A.2, RF.K.2d, RF.K.3, RL.K.1

Give your learners extra practice with Christmas! This no-prep printable pack has 7 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Count the Christmas Things
  • Christmas Words
  • Build Christmas Words
  • Gifts for Everyone
  • Christmas Adding
  • Christmas Patterns
  • Christmas Memory
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Count the Christmas Things, Christmas Words, Build Christmas Words, Gifts for Everyone, Christmas Adding, Christmas Patterns, Christmas Memory), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Holidays, Art & Coding Bundle and the Mega Bundle.

Terms: one license for one home or one teacher. Please do not share or post publicly. Thank you!
